				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<h2>Live streamed on YouTube</h2>
Council meetings are live streamed on <a href="https://www.youtube.com/user/devonportcitycouncil" target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="Council’s YouTube channel - open in a new tab" data-uw-rm-ext-link="">Council’s YouTube channel</a> for those who are unable to attend in person. Questions may be submitted to the Council for inclusion at the meeting in accordance with <a href="https://www.devonport.tas.gov.au/wp-admin/admin-ajax.php?juwpfisadmin=false&action=wpfd&task=file.download&wpfd_category_id=360&wpfd_file_id=76340" target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="Council’s Public Question Time Policy. - open in a new tab" data-uw-rm-ext-link="">Council’s Public Question Time Policy.</a>								</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-64dadf1 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="64dadf1" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>Council meetings are generally held on the fourth Monday of each month, in the Aberdeen Room, level 2, paranaple centre, 137 Rooke Street Devonport, starting at 5.30pm.  You can view the meeting schedule <a href="https://www.devonport.tas.gov.au/council/council-meetings/meeting-schedule/" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="You can view the meeting schedule here" data-uw-rm-vglnk="" data-uw-rm-brl="PR" data-uw-original-href="/council/council-meetings/meeting-schedule/">here</a>.</p><p>Extraordinary meetings of the Council may also be called when needed.</p><p>Council meetings are held in accordance with the <a href="https://www.legislation.tas.gov.au/view/html/inforce/current/sr-2025-025" target="_blank" rel="noopener" data-uw-rm-brl="PR" data-uw-original-href="https://www.legislation.tas.gov.au/view/html/inforce/current/sr-2025-025" aria-label="Local Government (Meeting Procedures) Regulation 2025 - open in a new tab" data-uw-rm-ext-link="" data-uw-original->Local Government (Meeting Procedures) Regulation 2025</a>, to ensure that meetings are conducted:  </p><ul><li>with efficiency, impartiality, honesty and integrity;</li><li>within the spirit and letter of all relevant laws; and</li><li>in the best interest of the community.</li></ul><div class="landing-page-nav landing-3-col"><div class="grid"><div class="col-xs-12 col-m-4"><p><strong>Public Question Time – Questions on Notice</strong></p><p>This form <a href="https://aus01.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fforms.office.com%2FPages%2FResponsePage.aspx%3Fid%3D4trL5gQCUEeMaP5iW5LnAd_6zFYiQOBIqH46QSOpiy9UMTFURFNUMUFDQ0s4NU9ER0E0NUdQSFlYQS4u&data=05%7C02%7CCJordan%40devonport.tas.gov.au%7C6f4d17699df940aed6c808dd13f272eb%7Ce6cbdae2020447508c68fe625b92e701%7C0%7C0%7C638688654258183243%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=Tu50ZL%2FMgyz0vM1DmmISDJIm%2Fif%2BYEFCHuYrdVPJ7lI%3D&reserved=0" data-uw-rm-brl="PR" data-uw-original-href="https://aus01.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fforms.office.com%2FPages%2FResponsePage.aspx%3Fid%3D4trL5gQCUEeMaP5iW5LnAd_6zFYiQOBIqH46QSOpiy9UMTFURFNUMUFDQ0s4NU9ER0E0NUdQSFlYQS4u&data=05%7C02%7CCJordan%40devonport.tas.gov.au%7C6f4d17699df940aed6c808dd13f272eb%7Ce6cbdae2020447508c68fe625b92e701%7C0%7C0%7C638688654258183243%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=Tu50ZL%2FMgyz0vM1DmmISDJIm%2Fif%2BYEFCHuYrdVPJ7lI%3D&reserved=0" data-uw-original->Online Public Questions on Notice Form</a> can be completed if you wish to submit a question on notice to be tabled in a public Council meeting agenda. Please note, in accordance with Council’s <a href="https://www.devonport.tas.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/Public-Question-Time-Policy.pdf" data-uw-pdf-br="2" data-uw-pdf-doc="">Public Question Time Policy</a>, that a maximum of three questions per person per meeting may be submitted on notice for the Council Meeting Agenda.  Additional questions will be treated as general correspondence, and a response provided in accordance with Council’s Customer Service Charter.</p><p>Council also accepts questions on notice that are submitted via email, post or delivered in person to the Council Chambers, but request that the information and format contained in the online form are used as a guide for the submitting and format of questions on notice received.</p><p>If you simply wish to send Council a question for a general enquiry, please make use of the form on our website – <a href="https://aus01.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.devonport.tas.gov.au%2Fcouncil%2Freport-an-issue%2F&data=05%7C02%7CCJordan%40devonport.tas.gov.au%7C6f4d17699df940aed6c808dd13f272eb%7Ce6cbdae2020447508c68fe625b92e701%7C0%7C0%7C638688654258193075%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=Y%2BbV8OHNEOre0rY1tlnl1SsjHO49Gn6Yr8RSPS7fe%2B4%3D&reserved=0" data-uw-rm-brl="PR" data-uw-original-href="https://aus01.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.devonport.tas.gov.au%2Fcouncil%2Freport-an-issue%2F&data=05%7C02%7CCJordan%40devonport.tas.gov.au%7C6f4d17699df940aed6c808dd13f272eb%7Ce6cbdae2020447508c68fe625b92e701%7C0%7C0%7C638688654258193075%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=Y%2BbV8OHNEOre0rY1tlnl1SsjHO49Gn6Yr8RSPS7fe%2B4%3D&reserved=0" <script>
(function() {
    function init() {
        let chatLoaded = false;

        function loadChatWidget() {
            document.getElementById('myChatFrame').src = 
              "https://copilotstudio.microsoft.com/environments/08bbf0f8-0d93-ef90-80f2-c929f56ab7ce/bots/cr3e1_copilot/webchat?__version__=2&t=" + new Date().getTime();
            chatLoaded = true;
        }

        if (performance.navigation.type === 1) { 
            localStorage.removeItem('roseWelcomeDismissedTime');
        }

        const HOURS_TO_WAIT = 48; 
        const localStorageKey = 'roseWelcomeDismissedTime';

        function showWelcomeBubble() {
          if (window.innerWidth > 768) {
            document.getElementById('myWelcomeBubble').style.display = 'block';
          }
        }

        const lastDismissed = localStorage.getItem(localStorageKey);
        if (!lastDismissed) {
          setTimeout(showWelcomeBubble, 2000);
        } else {
          const lastTime = parseInt(lastDismissed, 10);
          const now = Date.now();
          const hoursSinceDismissed = (now - lastTime) / (1000 * 60 * 60);
          if (hoursSinceDismissed >= HOURS_TO_WAIT) {
            setTimeout(showWelcomeBubble, 2000);
          }
        }

        document.getElementById('myBubbleCloseBtn').addEventListener('click', function(ev) {
          ev.stopPropagation(); 
          document.getElementById('myWelcomeBubble').style.display = 'none';
          localStorage.setItem(localStorageKey, Date.now().toString());
        });

        document.getElementById('myWelcomeBubble').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          if (e.target.id !== 'myBubbleCloseBtn') {
            openChatAndDismiss();
          }
        });

        const chatContainer = document.getElementById('myChatContainer');

        document.getElementById('myOpenChatButton').addEventListener('click', function() {
          if (chatContainer.style.display === 'block') {
            chatContainer.style.display = 'none';
          } else {
            openChatAndDismiss();
          }
        });

        document.getElementById('myCloseChatButton').addEventListener('click', function() {
          chatContainer.style.display = 'none';
        });

        function openChatAndDismiss() {
          chatContainer.style.display = 'block';
          document.getElementById('myWelcomeBubble').style.display = 'none';
          localStorage.setItem(localStorageKey, Date.now().toString());
          if (!chatLoaded) {
            loadChatWidget();
          }
        }
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
    } else {
        init();
    }
})();
</script>				</div>

			.unlimited-elements-background-overlay{
				position:absolute;
				top:0px;
				left:0px;
				width:100%;
				height:100%;
				z-index:0;

				z-index:999;

		<script type='text/javascript'>

			jQuery(document).ready(function(){
					
				function ucBackgroundOverlayPutStart(){
				
					var objBG = jQuery(".unlimited-elements-background-overlay").not(".uc-bg-attached");

					if(objBG.length == 0)
						return(false);

					objBG.each(function(index, bgElement){

						var objBgElement = jQuery(bgElement);

						var targetID = objBgElement.data("forid");

						var location = objBgElement.data("location");

						switch(location){
							case "body":
							case "body_front":
								var objTarget = jQuery("body");
							break;
							case "layout":
							case "layout_front":
								var objLayout = jQuery("*[data-id=\""+targetID+"\"]");
								var objTarget = objLayout.parents(".elementor");
								if(objTarget.length > 1)
									objTarget = jQuery(objTarget[0]);
							break;
							default:
								var objTarget = jQuery("*[data-id=\""+targetID+"\"]");
							break;
						}


						if(objTarget.length == 0)
							return(true);

						var objVideoContainer = objTarget.children(".elementor-background-video-container");

						if(objVideoContainer.length == 1)
							objBgElement.detach().insertAfter(objVideoContainer).show();
						else
							objBgElement.detach().prependTo(objTarget).show();


						var objTemplate = objBgElement.children("template");

						if(objTemplate.length){
							
					        var clonedContent = objTemplate[0].content.cloneNode(true);

					    	var objScripts = jQuery(clonedContent).find("script");
					    	if(objScripts.length)
					    		objScripts.attr("type","text/javascript");
					        
					        objBgElement.append(clonedContent);
							
							objTemplate.remove();
						}

						objBgElement.trigger("bg_attached");
						objBgElement.addClass("uc-bg-attached");

					});
				}

				ucBackgroundOverlayPutStart();

				jQuery( document ).on( 'elementor/popup/show', ucBackgroundOverlayPutStart);
				jQuery( "body" ).on( 'uc_dom_updated', ucBackgroundOverlayPutStart);

			});

<!-- 2) Welcome Bubble -->
<div id="myWelcomeBubble">
  <button id="myBubbleCloseBtn" aria-label="Dismiss bubble">×</button>
  <p>Hi my name is Rose. How can I help you today?</p>
</div>

<!-- 3) Chat Popup -->
<div id="myChatContainer" style="display:none;">
  <button id="myCloseChatButton" aria-label="Close Chat">×</button>
  <iframe id="myChatFrame"></iframe>
</div>

<style>
  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    #myWelcomeBubble {
      display: none !important;
    }
  }

  #myBubbleCloseBtn {
    all: unset !important;
    position: absolute !important;
    top: 6px !important;
    right: 8px !important;
    color: #292626 !important;
    font-size: 20px !important;
    cursor: pointer !important;
  }
</style>

<script>
(function() {
    function init() {
        let chatLoaded = false;

        function loadChatWidget() {
            document.getElementById('myChatFrame').src = 
              "https://copilotstudio.microsoft.com/environments/08bbf0f8-0d93-ef90-80f2-c929f56ab7ce/bots/cr3e1_copilot/webchat?__version__=2&t=" + new Date().getTime();
            chatLoaded = true;
        }

        if (performance.navigation.type === 1) { 
            localStorage.removeItem('roseWelcomeDismissedTime');
        }

        const HOURS_TO_WAIT = 48; 
        const localStorageKey = 'roseWelcomeDismissedTime';

        function showWelcomeBubble() {
          if (window.innerWidth > 768) {
            document.getElementById('myWelcomeBubble').style.display = 'block';
          }
        }

        const lastDismissed = localStorage.getItem(localStorageKey);
        if (!lastDismissed) {
          setTimeout(showWelcomeBubble, 2000);
        } else {
          const lastTime = parseInt(lastDismissed, 10);
          const now = Date.now();
          const hoursSinceDismissed = (now - lastTime) / (1000 * 60 * 60);
          if (hoursSinceDismissed >= HOURS_TO_WAIT) {
            setTimeout(showWelcomeBubble, 2000);
          }
        }

        document.getElementById('myBubbleCloseBtn').addEventListener('click', function(ev) {
          ev.stopPropagation(); 
          document.getElementById('myWelcomeBubble').style.display = 'none';
          localStorage.setItem(localStorageKey, Date.now().toString());
        });

        document.getElementById('myWelcomeBubble').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          if (e.target.id !== 'myBubbleCloseBtn') {
            openChatAndDismiss();
          }
        });

        const chatContainer = document.getElementById('myChatContainer');

        document.getElementById('myOpenChatButton').addEventListener('click', function() {
          if (chatContainer.style.display === 'block') {
            chatContainer.style.display = 'none';
          } else {
            openChatAndDismiss();
          }
        });

        document.getElementById('myCloseChatButton').addEventListener('click', function() {
          chatContainer.style.display = 'none';
        });

        function openChatAndDismiss() {
          chatContainer.style.display = 'block';
          document.getElementById('myWelcomeBubble').style.display = 'none';
          localStorage.setItem(localStorageKey, Date.now().toString());
          if (!chatLoaded) {
            loadChatWidget();
          }
        }
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
    } else {
        init();
    }
})();
</script>				</div>

					const lazyloadRunObserver = () => {
						const lazyloadBackgrounds = document.querySelectorAll( `.e-con.e-parent:not(.e-lazyloaded)` );
						const lazyloadBackgroundObserver = new IntersectionObserver( ( entries ) => {
							entries.forEach( ( entry ) => {
								if ( entry.isIntersecting ) {
									let lazyloadBackground = entry.target;
									if( lazyloadBackground ) {
										lazyloadBackground.classList.add( 'e-lazyloaded' );
									}
									lazyloadBackgroundObserver.unobserve( entry.target );
								}
							});
						}, { rootMargin: '200px 0px 200px 0px' } );
						lazyloadBackgrounds.forEach( ( lazyloadBackground ) => {
							lazyloadBackgroundObserver.observe( lazyloadBackground );
						} );
					};
					const events = [
						'DOMContentLoaded',
						'elementor/lazyload/observe',
					];
					events.forEach( ( event ) => {
						document.addEventListener( event, lazyloadRunObserver );
					} );
				} )();

				function ucBackgroundOverlayPutStart(){
				
					var objBG = jQuery(".unlimited-elements-background-overlay").not(".uc-bg-attached");

						return(false);

					objBG.each(function(index, bgElement){

						var targetID = objBgElement.data("forid");

						var location = objBgElement.data("location");

						switch(location){

							case "body_front":
								var objTarget = jQuery("body");

				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>The Planning Authority Committee meets on an ‘as required’ basis and makes recommendations to the Council on planning and development application matters in accordance with Section 23 of the <em>Local Government Act 1993</em>.</p><p>Councillor representatives on the Planning Authority Committee are:</p><ul><li>Councillor Alison Jarman (Chair)</li><li>Councillor Stacey Sheehan</li><li>Councillor Gerard Enniss</li><li>Councillor Peter Hollister</li><li>Councillor Leigh Murphy</li><li>Councillor Damien Viney          </li></ul><p>The purpose of the Planning Authority Committee is to assess only those discretionary planning permit applications, where either a representation has been received, or where the application is recommended for refusal.</p><p>Where planning applications for significant developments are received, the General Manager may decide to refer these planning to the full Planning Authority (Council) for determination.</p><p>Please note that minutes of meetings will not be confirmed until the following Council meeting. The Planning Authority Committee operates under the <a href="https://www.devonport.tas.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/Planning-Authority-Committee-Terms-of-Refer_Claire-Jordan.pdf">Planning Authority Committee Terms of Reference.</a></p><p><strong>The next meeting date of Planning Authority Committee will be listed below, when known.</strong>  All Planning Authority Committee meetings will be held in the Aberdeen Room, level two, paranaple centre, 137 Rooke Street, Devonport and will be open to the public.</p><div><div class="grid"><div id="uid_1558589518024_9433" class="col-xs-12 col-lg-8" role="region" aria-label="Results of Search Minutes & Agendas"><div class="seamless-pagination-info right"> </div></div></div></div>								</div>

					<!-- 1) Chat Button -->
<button id="myOpenChatButton" aria-label="Toggle Chat" title="Toggle Chat"></button>

<!-- 2) Welcome Bubble -->
<div id="myWelcomeBubble">
  <button id="myBubbleCloseBtn" aria-label="Dismiss bubble">×</button>
  <p>Hi my name is Rose. How can I help you today?</p>
</div>

<!-- 3) Chat Popup -->
<div id="myChatContainer" style="display:none;">
  <button id="myCloseChatButton" aria-label="Close Chat">×</button>
  <iframe id="myChatFrame"></iframe>
</div>

<style>
  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    #myWelcomeBubble {
      display: none !important;
    }
  }

  #myBubbleCloseBtn {
    all: unset !important;
    position: absolute !important;
    top: 6px !important;
    right: 8px !important;
    color: #292626 !important;
    font-size: 20px !important;
    cursor: pointer !important;
  }
</style>

<script>
(function() {
    function init() {
        let chatLoaded = false;

        function loadChatWidget() {
            document.getElementById('myChatFrame').src = 
              "https://copilotstudio.microsoft.com/environments/08bbf0f8-0d93-ef90-80f2-c929f56ab7ce/bots/cr3e1_copilot/webchat?__version__=2&t=" + new Date().getTime();
            chatLoaded = true;
        }

        if (performance.navigation.type === 1) { 
            localStorage.removeItem('roseWelcomeDismissedTime');
        }

        const HOURS_TO_WAIT = 48; 
        const localStorageKey = 'roseWelcomeDismissedTime';

        function showWelcomeBubble() {
          if (window.innerWidth > 768) {
            document.getElementById('myWelcomeBubble').style.display = 'block';
          }
        }

        const lastDismissed = localStorage.getItem(localStorageKey);
        if (!lastDismissed) {
          setTimeout(showWelcomeBubble, 2000);
        } else {
          const lastTime = parseInt(lastDismissed, 10);
          const now = Date.now();
          const hoursSinceDismissed = (now - lastTime) / (1000 * 60 * 60);
          if (hoursSinceDismissed >= HOURS_TO_WAIT) {
            setTimeout(showWelcomeBubble, 2000);
          }
        }

        document.getElementById('myBubbleCloseBtn').addEventListener('click', function(ev) {
          ev.stopPropagation(); 
          document.getElementById('myWelcomeBubble').style.display = 'none';
          localStorage.setItem(localStorageKey, Date.now().toString());
        });

        document.getElementById('myWelcomeBubble').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          if (e.target.id !== 'myBubbleCloseBtn') {
            openChatAndDismiss();
          }
        });

        const chatContainer = document.getElementById('myChatContainer');

        document.getElementById('myOpenChatButton').addEventListener('click', function() {
          if (chatContainer.style.display === 'block') {
            chatContainer.style.display = 'none';
          } else {
            openChatAndDismiss();
          }
        });

        document.getElementById('myCloseChatButton').addEventListener('click', function() {
          chatContainer.style.display = 'none';
        });

        function openChatAndDismiss() {
          chatContainer.style.display = 'block';
          document.getElementById('myWelcomeBubble').style.display = 'none';
          localStorage.setItem(localStorageKey, Date.now().toString());
          if (!chatLoaded) {
            loadChatWidget();
          }
        }
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
    } else {
        init();
    }
})();
</script>				</div>

					var links = $('a');
					$.each(links, function(i,v){

						if ( window.location === window.parent.location ) {

						var param = 'external=1';
						var href = $(v).attr('href');
						if( 'undefined' === typeof href ){

				( () => {
					const lazyloadRunObserver = () => {
						const lazyloadBackgrounds = document.querySelectorAll( `.e-con.e-parent:not(.e-lazyloaded)` );
						const lazyloadBackgroundObserver = new IntersectionObserver( ( entries ) => {
							entries.forEach( ( entry ) => {
								if ( entry.isIntersecting ) {
									let lazyloadBackground = entry.target;
									if( lazyloadBackground ) {
										lazyloadBackground.classList.add( 'e-lazyloaded' );
									}
									lazyloadBackgroundObserver.unobserve( entry.target );
								}
							});
						}, { rootMargin: '200px 0px 200px 0px' } );
						lazyloadBackgrounds.forEach( ( lazyloadBackground ) => {
							lazyloadBackgroundObserver.observe( lazyloadBackground );
						} );
					};
					const events = [
						'DOMContentLoaded',
						'elementor/lazyload/observe',
					];
					events.forEach( ( event ) => {
						document.addEventListener( event, lazyloadRunObserver );
					} );
				} )();
			</script>

			jQuery(document).ready(function(){
					
				function ucBackgroundOverlayPutStart(){
				
					var objBG = jQuery(".unlimited-elements-background-overlay").not(".uc-bg-attached");

					if(objBG.length == 0)
						return(false);

					objBG.each(function(index, bgElement){

						var objBgElement = jQuery(bgElement);

						var targetID = objBgElement.data("forid");

						var location = objBgElement.data("location");

						switch(location){
							case "body":
							case "body_front":
								var objTarget = jQuery("body");
							break;
							case "layout":
							case "layout_front":
								var objLayout = jQuery("*[data-id=\""+targetID+"\"]");
								var objTarget = objLayout.parents(".elementor");
								if(objTarget.length > 1)
									objTarget = jQuery(objTarget[0]);
							break;
							default:
								var objTarget = jQuery("*[data-id=\""+targetID+"\"]");
							break;
						}


						if(objTarget.length == 0)
							return(true);

						var objVideoContainer = objTarget.children(".elementor-background-video-container");

						if(objVideoContainer.length == 1)
							objBgElement.detach().insertAfter(objVideoContainer).show();
						else
							objBgElement.detach().prependTo(objTarget).show();


						var objTemplate = objBgElement.children("template");

						if(objTemplate.length){
							
					        var clonedContent = objTemplate[0].content.cloneNode(true);

					    	var objScripts = jQuery(clonedContent).find("script");
					    	if(objScripts.length)
					    		objScripts.attr("type","text/javascript");
					        
					        objBgElement.append(clonedContent);
							
							objTemplate.remove();
						}

						objBgElement.trigger("bg_attached");
						objBgElement.addClass("uc-bg-attached");

					});
				}

				ucBackgroundOverlayPutStart();

				jQuery( document ).on( 'elementor/popup/show', ucBackgroundOverlayPutStart);
				jQuery( "body" ).on( 'uc_dom_updated', ucBackgroundOverlayPutStart);

			});


		</script>
		
</body>
</html>
